quandoUsar: Demos or game areas with a play-money balance where each gem found raises the multiplier and the person decides when to stop.
Games playable by keyboard: the 5 × 5 board has roving focus and arrow keys to move between tiles.
Explain risk and reward: more mines give bigger jumps in the multiplier, which is the fair payout minus `margin`.
quandoEvitar: Do not use with real money or prizes: the balance is play money and the mines are drawn in the browser with `random`.
Use `crash-game` when the tension should come from time, cashing out before a live curve crashes.
Use `plinko-game` or `slide-game` when the result should come out on its own, with no decisions during the round.

teclado.acao: On the board, move focus between tiles and stop at the edge, without wrapping.
Move focus to the first or last tile of the current row.
On a closed tile during the round, flips the tile.
Enters the board at the last focused tile, the only one in the focus order, and then moves on to the bet and mine controls.
On the main button, bets, cashes out after the first gem and bets again; it is the same `<button>` the whole time.
In the bet field, confirms the value and clamps it between `minBet` and the balance.

acessibilidade: The board is a `role="group"` with roving focus (only one tile has `tabIndex={0}`), and each tile states row, column and state (“hidden”, “gem” or “mine”) in its `aria-label`.
Tiles already flipped or outside a round use `aria-disabled` and stay in the navigation; each move is announced in a `role="status"` region, and the mine count in another live region.
Balance, bet shortcuts and main button follow the pattern of the other games, with `aria-disabled` to keep focus; all texts are in English.
movimento: Tiles flip in 3D with a spring with a slight bounce; at the end of the round, the remaining ones flip in a wave starting from the focused tile, and a mine makes the board shake.
The multiplier makes a small hop on each gem, the mine count rolls in the direction of the adjustment and, on a new bet, the open tiles close in a diagonal sweep.
With “reduce motion” on, tiles flip instantly, with no wave, shake, staggered entrance or hover lift.
responsivo: The card goes up to 40rem and is a container: when narrow, the board sits above the controls; from 34rem they sit side by side, with the panel at 15rem and the board up to 24rem.
notasIA: `mines` (1 to 24) can be controlled with `onMinesChange`; at the end of each round, `onRoundEnd` brings gems, multiplier, outcome (`cashed-out` or `mine`), bet and payout.
`random` is only called at bet time, to hide the mines, so a seeded generator makes the board repeatable; finding all the gems ends the round with an automatic cash-out.
Like the other games, it is play money with its own copy of `play-money.tsx`; the balance can be controlled with `balance` and `onBalanceChange`.
